name: stop-remind
description: The stop-remind Stop hook: asks Jev whether the finished turn needs a crux, SDLC or confidence reminder. A workspace member only to inherit the pinned typecheck, lint, and test — home/claude/hooks/stop-remind.sh execs stop-remind.ts under bun. Declare no dependencies here: a runtime dependency would make the hook need an installed node_modules. See the header of stop-remind.ts.
